analysis: Recurrent severe neutropenia and thrombocytopenia, progressing to grade 4, with subsequent anemia and thyroid dysfunction suggest cumulative bone marrow toxicity and multi-system involvement. The pattern indicates poor hematologic reserve and evolving endocrine complication, typical of aggressive disease or treatment-related effects. ECOG 2 and obesity further compromise physiological resilience.
evidences: Recurrent grade 4 neutropenia and thrombocytopenia with incomplete recovery
Progressive anemia and new-onset thyroid dysfunction (hyper- then hypothyroidism)
ECOG performance status 2 and obesity (BMI 32.4) indicating reduced functional reserve
